prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1285; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the motor vehicle collision described in your file. The claimant was injured when the vehicle they were driving was struck head-on at low speed. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact the claimant directly, as they are now represented.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this incident, together with a copy of the declarations page for each policy.

We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle inspection and repair records, telematics or event data recorder information, witness statements, recorded calls, claim notes, and any other materials in your possession or control. Please confirm in writing within ten days that these materials are being retained.

We look forward to your prompt response so that the claimant's medical and financial recovery can be addressed without delay.
